NAPA selects Hy-Tek and Hai Robotics for warehouse automation

The flow-center project combines HaiPick systems and multiple robots, with design evaluation at Hy-Tek’s Innovation Lab.

GlobeNewswire ↗15 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Automating parts fulfillment

Hy-Tek and Hai Robotics announced a project with NAPA Auto Parts to automate flow-center storage and retrieval. Hy-Tek is the integrator, while Hai Robotics supplies technology from its HaiPick Systems portfolio.

Design evaluation before deployment

Multiple robots will support varied SKU profiles in a coordinated storage-and-retrieval system. The team evaluated technology in Hy-Tek’s live Innovation Lab warehouse to refine the design before deployment, targeting density and scalable capacity.

Operating results are not yet disclosed

The announcement targets better accuracy and faster fulfillment but gives no robot count, investment, go-live date or post-installation performance. It establishes a technology and partner selection rather than verified quantitative operating results.
